items.content_text:

Hardware designers treat error as a budget. Software engineers treat it as a nuisance. The current trade-off in AI and HPC memory is blunt. You want to save energy, so you increase the bit error rate by using approximate computing. You accept that small numerical errors will be amortized by the iterative nature of the workload.
